# Business Verification Pack (Milestone 5C)

Prepared 2026-11-19. Documentation only: this pack publishes nothing, changes no page, route, SEO configuration, workbook or enquiry behaviour, and contacts no external account.

**Purpose.** Ten pages are planned (seven services, three locations) and every one is **BLOCKED — EVIDENCE PENDING**. This pack gathers everything the company must confirm before any of them can be written or published, into one register, one questionnaire and one readiness matrix.

## How to read a status

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| VERIFIED | Independent evidence is on file. **Nothing is VERIFIED today.** Website configuration, the claims registry and legacy documents never count as independent evidence. |
| PROVISIONAL | Approved public copy, or a single source, exists. It is not independently verified. |
| CONFLICTED | Two or more sources disagree. No source is chosen here. |
| MISSING | Nothing usable exists. |
| NOT APPLICABLE | No planned page needs it. |

Priority is derived by rule, not by opinion: *Critical* blocks publication of five or more pages or of a wave-1 page; *High* blocks another page, or a claim on five or more pages; *Medium* blocks a claim or a section; *Low* blocks nothing.

## Regenerating

`node --import ./tests/register.mjs scripts/seo/business-verification/build.mjs` rewrites the six generated documents. `tests/seo/business-verification.test.mjs` fails if they drift from the data.

## What this pack does not do

It does not invent management answers, choose between conflicting sources, assume any licence, publish a page, edit PRs #1 to #6, or change `lib/seo`, the workbook or any application code.
